definition: Stable internal record identifier
treatment: Platform-generated; source namespace preserved

definition: Evidence-supported project stage or observed-footprint state
treatment: Open geospatial rows remain Observed footprint; stage is not inferred

definition: Mapped building or campus area where the source provides it
treatment: Observed; not converted to MW

definition: Lower bound of a third-party published capacity estimate
treatment: Estimate only; never treated as planned, contracted, or energized

definition: Midpoint or point value of a third-party published capacity estimate
treatment: Estimate only; never treated as planned, contracted, or energized

definition: Upper bound of a third-party published capacity estimate
treatment: Estimate only; never treated as planned, contracted, or energized

definition: Source description of how a published capacity estimate was formed
treatment: Retained verbatim where available

definition: Announced or filed campus or data-center capacity
treatment: Reported; requires attributable project evidence

definition: Documented contracted utility service
treatment: Reported; not inferred from project capacity

definition: Capacity explicitly documented as energized
treatment: Reported; operating status alone is insufficient

definition: Confidence label assigned by an upstream third-party inventory
treatment: Metadata only; not promoted into platform Evidence Grade

definition: Record-level upstream citation supplied by the compiled inventory
treatment: Blank remains blank; dataset URL is retained separately

definition: Compute-manufacturing function
treatment: Analytical classification

definition: Expected project or portfolio expenditure
treatment: Reported; portfolio-deduplicated in summaries

definition: CHIPS direct award amount
treatment: Reported; funding scope controls aggregation

definition: Core AI, enabling compute, or broader compute classification
treatment: Analytical classification; not an official program field

definition: Authority and directness of the platform record
treatment: Assigned by platform contract, not copied from source confidence

definition: Recoverability and operational durability
treatment: Assigned by platform contract

definition: Monthly observation period for each retained G.17 value
treatment: Per-series latest dates are preserved; mixed latest dates are disclosed

definition: Exact Federal Reserve/FRED identifier for the displayed series
treatment: Controlled contract; display labels alone are insufficient

definition: Real output index for the contracted domestic manufacturing industry
treatment: Seasonally adjusted broad industry proxy; not AI-specific or a physical-unit count

definition: Estimated output relative to sustainable maximum industry output
treatment: Seasonally adjusted operating-rate estimate; not AI-specific capacity

definition: Latest retained observation compared with the checked official release
treatment: Any mismatch produces a visible warning and raises a validation error

definition: Published actual or expected ready-for-service date or year
treatment: Source value retained; year-only values are displayed as year-level trajectory evidence, not exact commissioning dates

definition: Online, under-construction, or planned/announced stage within the bounded active inventory
treatment: Counts apply only to the tracked project set and are not represented as a national census

definition: Private electric-power construction value put in place
treatment: Broad enabling-system capital-flow proxy; no AI-attributable share is inferred

definition: Operating facilities in the published national analysis.
treatment: National scale measure; facility definitions may include buildings campuses or named projects.

definition: Under-construction, planned, and land-banked facilities in the published national analysis.
treatment: Canceled and uncertain records are excluded.

definition: Reported project stage: proposed, approved/under construction, expanding, operating, suspended, or cancelled.
treatment: Used for the project funnel and state distributions.

definition: Proposed plus approved/under-construction plus expanding project records.
treatment: Measures visible development activity before full operation.

definition: Published capacity for projects or stage groups where disclosed.
treatment: Partial disclosure coverage; not inferred, not energized load, and not imputed for missing records.

definition: The dataset used for the observation.
treatment: National totals and project-development records retain their own definitions and dates.

definition: United States, Census region, state, or facility/project level.
treatment: Geographic levels remain explicit.
